integrity: A complete nine-page 2013 same-system mathematical PDF was inspected through its exact equations, equilibrium classification, Hopf curves, Lyapunov-coefficient calculations, and concluding remarks; document-wide searches found no moment, variance, invariant-measure, or average formulation. A complete open 2021 same-system article was inspected through its dynamical overview, chaotic parameter regimes, Poincare sections, unstable periodic-orbit construction, symbolic encoding, and bifurcation discussion; targeted full-text searches found no matching variance, invariant-measure, or conditional law. The 1992 foundational source was checked at bibliographic and abstract level and is not used for blanket full-document noncoverage. The memory representation, three conditional regressions, chord-excess identity, equality classification, and height excursion were independently reconstructed, and the algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The invariant-measure statements require compact support, while the memory formula requires a bounded complete trajectory.
For \(b>0\), the chord lower envelope is nonnegative only when \(0\le m\le b\), although the exact identity holds for every mean.
The theorem does not establish existence or uniqueness of a chaotic invariant measure for arbitrary parameters.
The original 1992 source was verified only at month resolution, so the structured date uses the earliest checked day-resolved same-system source rather than an invented day.
A differently phrased equivalent short invariant-measure identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Fixed-point chord excess and heightwise convective-energy calibration in the Rucklidge system
